scenes.text: Look closely at the color magenta, because it doesn’t actually exist in the physical world.
If you look at a natural rainbow, you can see every color of the spectrum, but magenta is completely missing.
Since magenta has no light wavelength of its own, it is actually a biological hallucination created inside your brain.
Tell me in the comments if this blew your mind, and follow for more secrets about how you see the world.
